text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President Ben Ali instructs Religious Affairs Minister Ali Chebbi to take care of mosques and religious educational programmes during fasting month of Ramadan which starts by January 10.
-President Ben Ali sign the appropriations law for 1997.
-Check up of electoral lists set for January to March 1997.
- National organisations and opposition parties send messages to President Ben Ali welcoming his speech at parliament on Saturday.
- Chronology of President's activities during the year 1996.
